messages:
Emma: quick ping — PR #4321 to onboard cascade-20b (https://github.com/redwood-inference/models/pull/4321). Summary: tokenizer tweak for eos handling, new quant profile "q4_tuned", model config + smoke evals.

Would love a quick review today; aiming to canary deploy tomorrow 09:00 PT. Biggest risk: tokenization changes could shift embeddings. Tests added under tests/tokenizer/cascade_e2e.py. CI is running.

Raj: on it, starting a run now. will check tokenizer unit tests and the smoke evals.

Miguel: heads-up — does this require Dedicated capacity bump? If so we need to talk to infra before canary.

Emma: @Miguel shouldn't need extra GPUs; it reuses existing 30g pool but will have slightly longer startup on first warmup. I can coordinate with infra if we see errors.

Sarah: quick note — tokenizer change changes eos->`<|endoftext|>` mapping. can we add a regression test asserting prior samples still map same? small snippet:
```
assert tok.decode(tok.encode("hello\n")) == "hello\n"
```

Raj: saw that — tests include sample roundtrip but I'll add an explicit assertion.

Kevin: I can review model-config and quant profile in 30m. @Emma can you add a short changelog entry in models/CHANGELOG.md? keeps audit easy for Private customers.

Emma: done, added entry and link in PR description.

CI-bot: CI started for PR #4321 — checks: unit, smoke-eval, quant-lint.

Raj: unit tests passing locally. pushing small test fix now.

CI-bot: unit ✅, smoke-eval ❌ (timeout on smoke-eval/cascade-quick), quant-lint ✅.

Sarah: smoke eval timeout looks like infra flake; can someone re-run smoke eval job? it's timed out at 4m.

Miguel: rerun queued. pinging eng-infra @oncall.

CI-bot: smoke-eval rerun started.

CI-bot: smoke-eval ✅.

Kevin: LGTM for config and quant profile, small nits in doc comments but non-blocking. Approving.

Raj: approve after I squash the tiny test fix (1 line).

Emma: thanks — we have 2 approvals. I'll merge after CI stays green for 10m and then kick the canary deploy script.

Emma: merging now.

CI-bot: Merge queued, merging when checks stable.

CI-bot: PR #4321 merged by Emma — sha abc1234.

Kevin: :tada: nice work

Miguel: will watch canary tomorrow morning, lmk if you want me to pause rollout on anomalies.

Emma: will do, thanks everyone :heart:
